headline: Welltower's Q2 FFO Beat Estimates on Strong SHO NOI Growth
summary: WELL's Q2 FFO beat and 20.5% SHO SSNOI growth fuel a higher 2026 outlook, while acquisitions strengthen its seniors housing focus.
